assumptions: Sapiens' language model, scored against human repertoires; the CDRs (and optionally the Vernier zone) are kept.
limits: A humanness score is not an immunogenicity measurement.
Mutations are proposed; binding must be re-measured.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which framework mutations does Sapiens make to humanize this variable domain, keeping the parental CDRs?

description: Humanize an antibody variable domain with Sapiens, the antibody language model behind BioPhi: score every position against human repertoires, take the highest-scoring residue in the frameworks, and keep the parental CDRs (and optionally the Kabat Vernier zone). Reports every mutation, and what the model would change next. Validated against the published PyTorch model on every chain of ANARCI's PDB benchmark.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

backmutateVernier.description: also keep the parental residues at the Kabat Vernier positions, which support the CDR loops.

cdrDefinition.description: which CDR definition marks the residues kept from the parental antibody. Values: imgt (IMGT), kabat (Kabat), chothia (Chothia), north (North).

domain.description: which variable domain to humanize when the sequence holds several (0-based, in sequence order).

humanizeCdrs.description: humanize the CDRs too instead of grafting the parental ones back (raises the risk of losing binding).

iterations.description: Sapiens passes, each re-scoring the previous output (BioPhi's default 1).

protein.description: the protein sequence (one-letter amino acids); the variable domains in it are found and numbered first.

name: humanize_antibody

identity.description: percent identity of the humanized domain to the parental one

mutations.description: each change: 0-based index in the domain, IMGT position, region, parental and humanized residue, and the model's probability for each
